parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing positives dominate: no trans-specific criminal offence, self-declaration recognition since 2015, hate-crime law explicitly covering gender identity in force since 2024, incitement protection, documented open LGBT scenes, 61% public support, anonymous reporting machinery, and no documented border, facility, or custody exposure actually applied to visitors. Negatives are mostly resident-facing (multi-year gender-care waits, conversion therapy unbanned, employment/housing coverage) or climate signals (a 2025 university study finding rising SOGI discrimination, an 18% historical hostility record corrected by 2018 state apologies). The custody concern — a bill limiting certificate effect 'for the purposes of imprisonment' — has only passed first stage with no documented enactment or application to a visitor, so it is an open question, not a tier-1 exposure. X-marker non-recognition is likewise an unanswered edge case. No trans-specific violence record exists either way.
